body:
Every Claude Code landing page ends up with the same rounded cards, one radius and the same grey shadow. Clients notice before you do.

Anthropic's frontend-design plugin names those tells in its own skill file, even its #D97757 terracotta on cream.

One command installs it. After that it turns on by itself whenever you ask Claude for frontend work.
ask_line: Comment TELLS and I'll send you the one-page checklist of the AI design tells plus the exact install command.
notes: fixture: the fake caption model's answer for the frozen test idea (M12)
